description: This file defines the ConstraintManager class in Drupal, which manages validation constraint plugins, including registration, creation, and filtering by data type.

classes.name: ConstraintManager
classes.description: A plugin manager class for handling validation constraints in Drupal, supporting registration, creation, and filtering of constraints based on data types.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ConstraintManager with namespace, cache backend, and module handler, setting up the factory and plugin discovery.

methods.name: getDiscovery
methods.description: Returns the plugin discovery object, wrapping it with a decorator if not already set.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new constraint plugin instance with specified options, handling deprecated non-array options.

methods.name: registerDefinitions
methods.description: Registers default constraint definitions for Symfony constraints.

methods.name: processDefinition
methods.description: Ensures the 'type' key in a plugin definition is either an array or FALSE.

methods.name: getDefinitionsByType
methods.description: Returns all constraint definitions supporting a specific data type.
